currentPage.seoDescription: Have a question? We’d be happy to help.
currentPage.title: Contact Us | Life.Church

01.headingText: Thanks for getting in touch with us. We look forward to getting to know you better! To get you to the team who can best serve you, here are some of the areas we connect people to most frequently.

0.title: Giving Help
0.content:
We’re grateful for your generosity! We’d love to share more about what it means to tithe, where your gifts go, and answer any questions you have about giving at Life.Church.

405-216-7054

giving@life.church

00.content:
We’re excited you’re interested in joining the Life.Church team! Want to learn more about what it’s like to work at Life.Church? Curious about our open roles? We’d love to tell you more.

Explore Careers at Life.Church

careers@life.church
00.title: Life.Church Careers

01.content:
Thank you for your interest in involving Life.Church or YouVersion in an upcoming story! We’re dedicated to serving you every step of the way. If you’ll share the nature of your request and the best way to contact you, we’ll be in touch with you very soon.

press@life.church
01.title: Press Inquiries

02.title: Life.Church Locations
02.content:
We can’t wait to meet you at one of our physical locations or at Life.Church Online! Are you looking for the Life.Church location nearest you? Do you have a question for the team at one of our locations? We’re ready to help!

Connect With Our Team 

Find a Location

03.title: YouVersion Help
03.content:
We’re so glad you’re exploring God’s Word through YouVersion! Do you have a question or comment for the YouVersion team? Do you need help with a Bible App issue? We’re eager to hear from you!

Contact the YouVersion Team

04.content:
We believe local churches like yours are the hope of the world, and we’d love to equip you with free resources, training, community, and apps through the Life.Church Open Network.

Explore Life.Church Open Network
04.title: Pastors & Church Leaders

05.title: Prayer Needs
05.content:
We would be honored to pray with you! We’ve got teams passionate about doing just that, so please share how we can be praying for you this week.

Share Your Prayer Request

06.title: Web & App Support
06.content:
We're so sorry to hear that you're having an issue with the Life.Church app or site! Your feedback and questions are valuable because they help us get better. Share what’s going on and we’ll do our best to help!

Get Web & App Support
